message.content:
The most famous sculpture of the 19th century is generally considered to be **“The Kiss”** by Auguste Rodin (completed in 1889).  

Rodin’s work captured the era’s fascination with realism, emotion, and the human form. “The Kiss” became an icon of modern sculpture, influencing countless artists and remaining one of the most reproduced and celebrated pieces worldwide. Its combination of technical mastery, expressive detail, and universal theme helped cement its status as the quintessential 19th‑century sculpture.
